name: effect-prophet
description: Effect-based time-series forecasting with a Rust/WASM numerical backend

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm:production && npm run build:typescript
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust/prophet-wasm --target nodejs --dev --out-dir ../../wasm && node tools/prepare-wasm-package.ts
scripts.build:wasm:production: wasm-pack build rust/prophet-wasm --target nodejs --release --out-dir ../../wasm && node tools/prepare-wasm-package.ts
scripts.test:integration:prophet: npm run build:wasm:production && vitest run --dir integration/tests/prophet-1.4.0
scripts.calendars:generate: docker compose --profile calendars-generate run --rm --build prophet-calendars-generate; status=$?; npm run --silent docker:clean; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; npm run calendars:verify
scripts.calendars:check: docker compose --profile calendars-check run --rm --build prophet-calendars-check; status=$?; npm run --silent docker:clean; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; npm run calendars:verify
scripts.fixtures:generate: docker compose --profile fixtures-generate run --rm --build prophet-fixtures-generate; status=$?; npm run --silent docker:clean; exit $status
scripts.fixtures:check: (docker compose --profile fixtures-check run --rm --build prophet-fixtures-check && docker compose --profile fixtures-check run --rm --build --no-deps effect-prophet-fixtures); status=$?; npm run --silent docker:clean; exit $status
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run format:rust:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:rust && npm run notices:check && npm run typecheck && npm run benchmark:typecheck && npm test && npm run benchmark:test && npm run test:integration:prophet && npm run test:rust && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:wasm:optimizer && npm run test:package
